Who We Are

About GB Group

A dedicated consultancy and agency bridging opportunities and delivering results in Jharkhand & West Bengal.

"Ek Chhat Ke Neeche 4 Badi Services"

GB Group was established to provide businesses, landowners, investors, and students with reliable, accountable, and transparent solutions across eastern India. Rather than navigating fragmented brokers and unverified intermediaries, GB Group brings four high-demand services into one professional agency.

We operate actively across both Jharkhand and West Bengal, leveraging deep on-ground networks, legal awareness, logistics coordination, and market connections to achieve superior outcomes for our clients.

No Middlemen

Direct communication with the agency and leadership for fast execution.

Legal & Verified

Every land parcel, export paper, and educational tie-up undergoes verification.

Regional Expertise

Specialized understanding of business dynamics in Jharkhand and West Bengal.

Complete Accountability

We stand by our commitments from consultation through delivery.

Our Four Specialized Pillars

1. Transport & Export

Linking manufacturers and traders in Jharkhand to national markets and Haldia/Kolkata ports for seamless domestic movement and export documentation.

2. Education Consultant & Placement

Guiding students from school to campus and career. Admissions into accredited colleges, scholarship assistance, and direct placement opportunities.

3. Land Sales & Joint Work

Structuring fair, legally sound joint venture collaborations between landowners and real estate developers, alongside verified plot sales.

4. Advertisement & Marketing

Creating modern visibility for companies through targeted digital campaigns, high-traffic hoarding placements, and local promotional drives.
